name: Kyra
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c136561]Asha[/url] is her younger sister.

Brash, aggressive, intelligent and voracious are some of the traits this woman possesses in abundance. She's one of the leaders of the Raiders, and one of the few people of Asian descent I know.

She and her sister Asha seem to be at the head of one of the strongest Raider groups.
